task: sign up for Medicare Part A and Part B at 65

steps.text: Check if you receive Social Security or Railroad Retirement Board benefits; if so, you will be automatically enrolled in Part A and Part B starting the first day of the month you turn 65.
If you are not receiving those benefits, visit SSA.gov/medicare/sign-up to apply for Part A and Part B.
Contact Social Security 3 months before you turn 65 to set up an appointment if you prefer not to apply online.
If you worked for a railroad, visit RRB.gov or call the RRB at 1-877-772-5772 (TTY users call 1-312-751-4701).

Enroll during your Initial Enrollment Period: the 7-month period starting 3 months before your 65th birthday month and ending 3 months after (if your birthday is on the 1st, the period starts 4 months before and ends 2 months after).
If you miss the Initial Enrollment Period, you can sign up during the General Enrollment Period (January 1–March 31 each year), but you may pay a late enrollment penalty.
After signing up, review your Medicare coverage options to decide what best meets your needs.
